title: Banking Companies Recovery of Loans Amendment Act 1992

sections.shortTitle: Banking Companies Recovery of Loans Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVII OF 1992
ACT XVII OF 1992
BANKING COMPANIES
(RECOVERY OF LOANS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the Banking Companies (Recovery of Loans) Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 1st August, 1992]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 26th July, 1992, and
is hereby published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.-----(1) This Act may be called the Banking Companies
(Recovery of Loans) (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Banking Companies Recovery of Loans Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Amendment of section 2, Ordinance XIX of 1979

ACT XVII OF 1992
ACT XVII OF 1992
BANKING COMPANIES
(RECOVERY OF LOANS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the Banking Companies (Recovery of Loans) Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 1st August, 1992]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 26th July, 1992, and
is hereby published for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 2,
Ordinance XIX of 1979:-----In the Banking Companies (Recovery of Loans)
Ordinance, 1979 (XIX of 1979), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance,
in section 2, in clause (f), for the words "one million" the words
"ten million" shall be substituted.
